written.title: Written exam — what to expect
written.instruction: This is a written exam. You will take it in class on the exam date. Read every question carefully and write your answers on the paper.
written.instructionUz: Bu yozma imtihon. Siz uni sinfda, imtihon kunida topshirasiz. Har bir savolni diqqat bilan o'qing va javoblarni qog'ozga yozing.
written.howto: Write each answer on the paper in your own words. Give more attention to the questions you find difficult. Do not talk to other students, and ask the teacher if a question is unclear.
written.howtoUz: Har bir javobni qog'ozga o'z so'zlaringiz bilan yozing. Qiyinroq savollarga ko'proq e'tibor bering. Boshqa o'quvchilar bilan gaplashmang, savol tushunarsiz bo'lsa o'qituvchidan so'rang.
written.sample: A correct task looks like this: on the paper the teacher writes a question such as “Write three sentences about your best friend.” Your answer is a short written text underneath it.
written.sampleUz: To'g'ri bajarilish misoli: varaqada o'qituvchi, masalan, “Eng yaqin do'stingiz haqida uchta gap yozing” degan topshiriq yozadi. Sizning javobingiz esa uning ostiga yozilgan qisqa matndan iborat.

oral.title: Oral exam — what to expect
oral.instruction: This is a speaking exam. The teacher will ask you questions and you answer by speaking in English, out loud.
oral.instructionUz: Bu og'zaki imtihon. O'qituvchi sizga savollar beradi, siz esa ingliz tilida baland ovozda javob berasiz.
oral.howto: Listen to the whole question before you answer. Speak in full sentences and take a moment to think if you need to. Your spoken answers are graded.
oral.howtoUz: Javob berishdan oldin savolni oxirigacha eshiting. To'liq gaplar bilan javob bering va kerak bo'lsa o'ylab olishga vaqt oling. Og'zaki javoblaringiz baholanadi.
oral.sample: A correct answer looks like this: the teacher asks “What did you do last weekend?” You answer out loud: “Last weekend I visited my grandmother.”
oral.sampleUz: To'g'ri javob misoli: o'qituvchi “O'tgan hafta oxirida nima qildingiz?” deb so'raydi. Siz esa: “O'tgan hafta oxirida buvimnikiga bordim” deb javob berasiz.

result.title: Your result — how to read it
result.instruction: This exam is already graded. Your score shows how many points you got out of the maximum, and the bar shows the same as a percentage.
result.instructionUz: Bu imtihon allaqachon baholangan. Sizning balingiz maksimal balldan qancha olganingizni ko'rsatadi, chiziq esa shuni foizda ifodalaydi.
result.howto: Read the teacher's comment below your score and use it to prepare better next time. If you do not understand a mark, ask your teacher about it.
result.howtoUz: Balingiz ostidagi o'qituvchi izohini o'qing va keyingi safar yaxshiroq tayyorlanish uchun undan foydalaning. Agar biron baho tushunarsiz bo'lsa, o'qituvchingizdan so'rang.
result.sample: A correct result looks like this: a score of 18 out of 20 shows as 18/20 and 90%. A comment such as “Good job! Review the past tense” tells you what to practise.
result.sampleUz: To'g'ri natija misoli: 20 balldan 18 ball 18/20 va 90% ko'rinishida bo'ladi. “Barakalla! O'tgan zamonni takrorlang” kabi izoh esa nima ustida mashq qilishni bildiradi.
